# ezghcloud_vpc (Data Source)

Look up an existing EZGH Cloud vpc by its canonical ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed resource ID.
- `project_id` (String) Project containing the resource.

### Read-Only

- `default_firewall_id` (String) Default firewall ID.
- `description` (String) Resource description.
- `ipv4_cidr` (String) IPv4 address space.
- `ipv6_cidr` (String) Service-assigned IPv6 address space.
- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization containing the resource.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) Service status.
- `tags` (Map of String) Customer resource tags.
